author: iFixit
description:
With the ThinkPad T14 Gen 7 and its bigger sibling, the T16 Gen 5, Lenovo’s proven that repairable design is possible at the biggest scale in the world.

Lenovo’s the best-selling laptop brand. They’ve got over 40% of the entire enterprise laptop market. We’re talking about one hundred Mount Everests worth of laptops: If you stacked the over 48 million Lenovo laptops sold in 2025, they’d be taller than the highest mountain on earth… by nearly 100 times.

And this year, two of their flagship T-series business laptops have earned 10 out of 10 repairability scores.
